title: fix: a disabled package's objects leave /auth/me/permissions, and actions that launch into it are no longer served
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X979Kx3AubFKK4ummmSgfoA)_

Fixes #28877

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：包被停用后，`/auth/me/permissions` 不再授予该包的对象（`current_user.can()` 随之答 false）；另一个启用包里"启动进停用包"的动作（flow 目标只有停用包提供、或参数 `objectOverride` 指向停用包对象）不再出现在对象的动作列表和 `/meta/action` 里；绑在停用包对象上的动作也不再列在 `/meta/action`。
- **为什么改**：#28117 裁决 A 规定停用 = 隐藏 + 数据面拒绝。HotCRM 实测这两处仍按启用作答：按钮照画、点开报 "Flow not found" 或参数框报错。
- **风险与回滚**：只在有包被停用时生效，重新启用即恢复，无需重启。执行面（`getMetaItemsForExecution`）、代码层（`getArtifactItem`）和包导出不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`（`isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage` 与 `attachBoundActions` 的自有动作过滤）、`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`（第 7 步）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（action 列表过滤只在 effective served 面）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts src/package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`，预期 47 条全绿，其中 `[#28877]` 两组共 8 条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Row 1: the permission map.** `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` (`@objectstack/core`) gains an optional `isObjectPackageDisabled` accessor on its schema source and, as a new last step, leaves out every object it answers `true` for. The `'*'` entry is not an object and stays. `registryObjectPackageDisabled(registry)` is the one reading of that accessor: the engine registry's own `isObjectPackageDisabled`, the predicate the data plane asks before `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. Both builders of the map hand it over, so `/auth/me/permissions` (`plugin-hono-server`) and `ISecurityService.getEffectiveObjectPermissions` (`plugin-security`, the map the server's own `current_user.can()` reads) stay byte-for-byte the same answer. An object the map does not mention answers `can()` false (`@objectstack/formula`'s binding).

**Row 2: actions that launch into a disabled package.** #24400's rule lives in `SchemaRegistry.boundServedActions`: a disabled package's bound actions are not attached. It now asks `isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage(action)`, which extends that rule: the action's own package is disabled (unchanged), OR its `objectName` object belongs to a disabled package (see Acceptance notes), OR a `type: 'flow'` target is a flow only disabled packages ship (`isFlowOfDisabledPackage`: at least one registered flow of that name, all of them in disabled packages), OR a param's `objectOverride` names an object of a disabled package (`isObjectPackageDisabled`). The same predicate is asked in three more places, and nowhere else:

- `attachBoundActions` on the SERVED layer filters the object's own `actions` too. HotCRM's `generate_quote` and `add_contact_to_campaign` sit there, because `defineStack()` merges a same-stack bound action into its object. The code layer keeps what the package ships.
- The protocol's effective served list for `action` (`GET /meta/action`) and the served by-name read (`GET /meta/action/NAME`, answered as a name with nothing behind it), through one helper `isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage(registry, item)` beside `isItemOfDisabledPackage`. The execution list and the per-package list (the package export) do not ask it.

Cache: a disable or enable already drops every fold (#24400). A flow registered or unregistered while some package is disabled, a package uninstall that removes flows, and the uninstall of a disabled package now drop every fold too, since each can change a verdict.

**Row 3** (the param dialog's wording) is not changed here: with the action withheld, the dialog is not reached.

## Why

#28117 ruling A: a disabled package is hidden and refused on the data plane. HotCRM measured on 18.2.0 (hotcrm#2383 comment 6567537276) that with a module disabled, `/auth/me/permissions` still granted its objects (so every action gated on `current_user.can()` stayed drawn), and an app action launching the module's flow was still served and failed with "Flow 'quote_generation' not found".

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts`, new block `[#28877]` (5 cases) on the #24400 harness (real `ObjectQL` + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`): a MODULE package with an object and a flow, a LAUNCHER package with an inline flow action, a bound flow action, an `objectOverride` action and three controls (an enabled flow, a field param on its own object, a URL naming the module's object in its text). Control before the disable; after it, the served object (`getMetaItem` object and `registry.getObject`), `getMetaItems` action and the by-name action read withhold exactly the two launching actions plus the inline one; re-enable restores them with no restart; a flow an enabled package also ships (registered after the disable) keeps the action; the execution list and the code layer keep everything.
- `packages/objectql/src/package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`, new block `[#28877]` (3 cases) on the real `SchemaRegistry` harness: a plain wildcard, an explicit grant and a super-user seed all reach the map while enabled; disabled, the object leaves the map and `can()` answers false for read, create, edit and delete, the other package is untouched, `'*'` stays, and the data plane refuses the same object `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`; re-enabled, the grant is back.
- `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (4 cases): the omission over each entry source, `'*'` kept, no accessor or a throwing one leaves the map whole (warned), and `registryObjectPackageDisabled` asks the registry's own method.
- `plugin-hono-server` `current-user-endpoints-effective-objects.test.ts` (1 case) and `plugin-security` `get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` (1 case, and the shared `endpointObjects` reference now hands the accessor too): each door leaves out a disabled object, byte-equal to the core function; the security case evaluates `current_user.can('deal', 'read')` through `ExpressionEngine` and gets `false`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Admin and member readers.** Row 1 is measured for a super-user (`ops_admin`, objects reached by the seed) and a member (`sales`, an explicit grant) in the security pin, and for the plain-wildcard and explicit-grant shapes in the objectql pin. Row 2 reads no caller: the withholding is in the served metadata, the same for every reader.
- **Bounded in-place fix: an action bound to a disabled package's object.** The order says "withheld wherever #24400 withholds an action bound to a disabled package's object". Measured on the first head (de04ea75, whose predicate had no `objectName` arm, so this case read as on `main`): with the module disabled, an enabled package's `url` action bound by `objectName` to the module's object was still in `getMetaItems({ type: 'action' })` and served by name, while `getMetaItem` of that object threw `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` (probe output `listed= true byName= true object= OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`). #24400 hid it only by hiding its object. Same defect class, one mechanical arm on the same predicate, same files and gate families, so it is fixed here: the predicate's `objectName` arm, pinned by `bound_to_member` in the `[#28877]` block (ablating the arm reds only the "disabled" case, 46/47).
- **The dispatch door is unchanged.** `POST /actions/OBJECT/ACTION` reads the action through the execution face, which this PR does not filter. What a withheld action answers there depends on where it is declared. One that keeps a top-level copy (a bound action registered as a standalone `action` item, as HotCRM's `generate_quote` is) still resolves and answers the launch's own refusal: `404` "Flow … not found" for a disabled flow. One declared only inside its object's `actions` (like `inline_enroll` in the test) is no longer in the served object it is resolved from, so the door answers the ADR-0110 D3 "no declaration" `404` (reading from the contract review, comment 6569625622; not re-measured on this head). Either way the console no longer draws the button, so the path is not reached from it.
- **The `fields` slot of `/auth/me/permissions`** is not pruned: its keys are `OBJECT.FIELD` entries of authored sets, and the order names the `objects` map only.
- **Row 3.** The param dialog's text is not reworded: once row 2 withholds the action, the dialog is not reached.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `934a10f5` unless a block says otherwise. Head `0a0e0022` changes only the changeset (five packages `minor` to `patch`, `Metadata-protocol: none`); `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-adr-0087-registration` (and its `--self-test`) exit 0 on it. Every ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (or a `git checkout BASE` leg with a `trap` restore and HEAD-blob hash check), each mutated package was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proved the marker left or reached `dist/` before the run was read. Every restore ended with `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` clean.

objectql `bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts` + `package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`: 2 failed / 45 passed. Red: "disabled: the flow-target and objectOverride actions leave the served object and GET /meta/action" and "a flow an enabled package also ships keeps the action…" (its first assertion reads main serving the action). Green on main as they should be: the before-disable control, re-enable, and execution list / code layer. Every row-1 file green (core 41/41, hono 6/6, security 65/65).
</details>

Overlap re-read before opening: open PRs searched for `effective-object-permissions`, `isObjectPackageDisabled`, `attachBoundActions`, "disabled package", "me/permissions"; the two hits (#28903, #28889) touch none of this diff's files.
